create_imagenet_dataloader: create an ImageNet dataset and distributed DataLoader with configurable batch size and transforms
build_imagenet_dataset: build an ImageNet dataset wrapper that optionally copies data locally from a network tar file
filter_imagenet_subset: filter an ImageNet dataset to a subset of images specified in a text file
copy_imagenet_locally: copy ImageNet tar data locally to a SLURM scratch directory for faster access
review_imagenet_class: review the ImageNet class that extends torchvision ImageFolder with local data copying and target indexing
